extracted.intended_audience: prospective grantees, partners, and the general public interested in Walton Family Foundation's priorities and approach
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational 'About Us' page describing the Walton Family Foundation's mission, vision, priority program areas, and governing values that guide grantmaking and partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — long-term, urgent approach to create access to opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: We are a family-led foundation that tackles tough social and environmental problems with urgency and a long-term approach to create access to opportunity for people and communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As we focus on making an impact that improves lives today, we want to ensure it lasts to benefit future generations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision — opportunity and encouragement
rubrics_metrics.description: To live in a world where people can accomplish anything when they have opportunity and encouragement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority area — education and lifelong opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthening the connections between education and lifelong opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as one of three core areas the foundation works in; implies preference for efforts that link education to long-term opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority area — protecting rivers, oceans and supporting communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Protecting rivers, oceans and the communities they support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core area of work; indicates environmental and community-focused conservation work is a funding priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority area — advancing Northwest Arkansas and the Arkansas–Mississippi Delta
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing our home region of Northwest Arkansas and the Arkansas-Mississippi Delta.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional economic, social, and community development in these geographies is explicitly prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — ROOTED
rubrics_metrics.description: ROOTED in the places we work and in a family legacy of giving back.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals preference for place-based work and long-standing community ties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — ACTIVE
rubrics_metrics.description: ACTIVE in our work with grantees and in enabling individuals to take an active role in determining their futures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggests collaborative, engaged partnerships and support for empowering individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — STEADY
rubrics_metrics.description: STEADY in our focused approach to creating lasting change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes sustained, focused efforts over one-time or short-term interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — BOLD
rubrics_metrics.description: BOLD in our belief about what’s possible and in tackling big, complex problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates willingness to fund ambitious or systemic work that addresses complex challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value — OPEN
rubrics_metrics.description: OPEN about who we are and to ideas from anywhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conveys receptiveness to diverse ideas and transparency about the foundation's identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-sector collaboration and diverse perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: We do this by bringing diverse perspectives to the same table: caregivers and conservationists, educators and entrepreneurs, farmers and futurists, doers and dreamers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foundation emphasizes convening different stakeholders and sectors; proposals that demonstrate cross-sector engagement and diverse partnerships align with this approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listen to and prioritize ideas from those closest to the problem
rubrics_metrics.description: We seek out ideas from those closest to the problem - because they’re usually closest to finding effective, lasting and shared solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for community-informed solutions and approaches that elevate local voices and lived experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive, egalitarian decision-making rooted in family legacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Rooted in several generations of family, where no voice is louder than the next and different opinions are valued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies internal governance and external engagement that values multiple perspectives and resists top-down imposition of solutions.
